title: Deep Autoencoder
paper_title: Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks
core_mech: 逐层 RBM 生成式预训练初始化深层对称 encoder–decoder，再以全局重建误差微调非线性 bottleneck。
core_mech_en: Layer-by-layer Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) generative pretraining initializing a deep symmetric encoder–decoder fine-tuned via global reconstruction error.
input_desc: 高维数据向量或展平图像
input_en: High-dimensional input vector or flattened image patch
output_desc: 低维 bottleneck 表征与输入重建
output_en: Low-dimensional non-linear bottleneck code z and reconstructed input x̂

source.title: Deep Autoencoder
notes: Original Hinton/Salakhutdinov MATLAB release includes stacked RBM pretraining and conjugate-gradient fine-tuning. A plain randomly initialized autoencoder does not reproduce the 2006 training method.

adapter.name: Deep Autoencoder
adapter.mechanism: Layerwise contrastive-divergence RBM pretraining, Gaussian bottleneck, then unfolded untied autoencoder fine-tuning.
limitations: Two compact RBMs replace the paper's large four-layer example; default first two training calls pretrain and later calls fine-tune.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
